verdicts.question: According to HR_Leave_and_Attendance_Policy.pdf, what are the details regarding (Hr-Pol-01)?
verdicts.actual_answer: HR-Pol-01 covers annual paid leave entitlement for full-time permanent shore staff, including their accrual rate and conditions for taking paid annual leave. It also outlines sick leave policy with mandatory medical documentation for certain absences, parental and compassionate leave, and details on how to carry forward unused leave days into the next calendar year.

actual_citations.excerpt: Full-time permanent shore staff accrue 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year (2.0 days per completed month of service). Employees may carry forward a maximum of 5

fact_checks.fact: Annual Paid Leave Entitlement
fact_checks.evidence: Full-time permanent shore staff accrue 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year (2.0 days per completed month of service).

fact_checks.fact: Sick Leave & Medical Documentation
fact_checks.evidence: A licensed physician's medical certificate is mandatory for any sick leave absence exceeding 3 consecutive working days, or if sick leave occurs immediately before or after a public holiday.

fact_checks.fact: Parental & Compassionate Leave
fact_checks.evidence: Primary caregivers are entitled to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave after 6 months of continuous shore employment. Secondary caregivers receive 4 weeks of paid leave.

fact_checks.fact: Carried Forward Unused Annual Leave Days
fact_checks.evidence: Employees may carry forward a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year. Any carried-forward days not used by March 31 are forfeited without cash payout.

fact_checks.fact: Core Working Hours & Travel Compensatory Off
fact_checks.evidence: Standard shore office hours are 09:00 to 17:30 Monday through Friday with mandatory core collaboration hours from 10:00 to 15:30. When shore staff perform mandatory weekend business travel under Remote_Work_and_Expense_Policy.pdf, 1 compensatory day off is granted for each full weekend day travelled, usable within 45 days.

fact_checks.fact: Hybrid Remote Work Eligibility
fact_checks.evidence: Permanent shore employees who have passed the 90-day probation period defined in HR_Leave_and_Attendance_Policy.pdf may work remotely up to 2 days per week with line manager approval. Tuesdays and Thursdays are designated anchor office days; remote days are normally scheduled on Mondays, Wednesdays, or Fridays.
